a=np.asarray(im.convert('RGB'))
print('shape',a.shape,'dtype',a.dtype)
# coarse tile mean colors in 12x8 grid

        t=a[gy*h//8:(gy+1)*h//8,gx*w//12:(gx+1)*w//12]

    print(' '.join(row))
